name: Sunsama
observation: A visible planner beside the promise, followed by a daily-workflow story.
adaptation: Put the financial calendar beside the headline. Explain a short monthly routine.
limit: Do not transfer its trial, integration or testimonial claims.

name: Daybridge
observation: Familiar calendar entries become the hero’s visual language.
adaptation: Use income, rent and savings dates to explain Aegis before listing features.
limit: Avoid a cloud of unrelated labels. Native-app and offline claims do not transfer.

name: Lunch Money
observation: Feature groups are organized around tracking, analysis and human context.
adaptation: Group Aegis around Record, Plan and Review, with a concrete example.
limit: Bank imports, pricing and testimonials are not Aegis facts. Browser verification prevented visual capture.

name: Actual Budget
observation: A product demo and explicit setup paths sit alongside data-ownership explanations.
adaptation: Provide a sample plus clear source, export and self-hosting destinations.
limit: Do not imply Aegis has equivalent offline or encryption guarantees. Screenshot capture stalled.

name: YNAB
observation: A familiar money concern leads into reassurance, setup and life outcomes.
adaptation: Open with a recognizable priority, then show the product action that supports it.
limit: Keep Aegis’s own voice. Do not reuse savings statistics, promises or customer evidence.

name: Wealthfront
observation: A focused offer and product view lead to explanations organized by service and life context.
adaptation: Let each chapter answer one decision, then connect a plan to its purpose.
limit: Rates, returns, deposit protections and investment-service claims do not transfer.

name: Mercury
observation: Product and demo paths sit within a broader story about building a business.
adaptation: Connect the reason to plan with a direct route into an example.
limit: No banking or adoption claims. Capture stalled, so no visual material or typography judgment is made.

name: Ramp
observation: An outcome-led opening is followed by a concrete financial workflow and grouped use cases.
adaptation: Show how one record relates to its date and budget.
limit: Leave out autonomous-agent claims, counters and the campaign treatment. Some captured imagery was still loading.

name: Chronicle
observation: Large output previews have named use-case controls immediately beside them.
adaptation: Use Now, Next and Later controls to change the financial example in place.
limit: Do not hide essential content behind motion. The second capture caught an unfinished reveal.

name: Raycast
observation: A bold dark opening leads into an enlarged interface demonstration.
adaptation: Give the DravenIQ-inspired direction one focal point, then show the product clearly.
limit: Preserve Aegis identity. Do not copy Raycast artwork or delay the useful product explanation.
